{{Top|leg}}
'''Senate Airlane Control''' was air control for the lanes around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They were especially active during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], halting any traffic without a valid authorization code as the Senate was restricted airspace.

[[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Reeze Duurmun]] encountered Senate Airlane Control on their comms as they piloted the [[Millennium Falcon|''Stellar Envoy'']] toward the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Senate Annex]].
